item.description: A set of island-dwelling animals including two animal remakes.

item.title: Atlantic Blue Marlin
item.description: Did you know the base game’s swordfish has the id of ‘marlin’? Anyways here’s the ACTUAL marlin. Featuring two different sprites for each gender!

item.title: Xiphactinus
item.description: Adds the giant x-ray fish to your zoo.

item.title: Yellowfin Tuna
item.description: Adds the kihada maguro to your zoo. Somewhat reasonably sized instead of whatever the base tuna has going on.

item.title: Xiphiorhynchus
item.description: Adds a xiphiorhynchus to your zoo created by Buffzoo.
